claims.statement: Each claim is attributed through a `sources` entry and a footnote keyed to its id → plan-sections

sources.title: Xonovex change-workflow conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original rules for writing the plan of a change and the first outline of its work, built on the contract of **recording-handoff**: the plan holds only what no other file holds, the generated block of links, settled things stated flat, and the ready or waiting split of the work

claims.statement: The plan links decisions and work and never copies them; the generated block is rewritten whole from the files that exist; only the plan-writing and plan-revising steps change `plan.md`, so an existing plan stops the run; a waiting work file names the decisions it waits on in `waits_on`; an unrecorded question is reported and never written as a decision file; the run starts with the entry step of **recording-handoff**.
